description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewSearchProperties' class, which extends 'ViewList' and manages the logic for displaying search property configurations within the SuiteCRM Connectors module. It handles setting display options, gathering connector source data, constructing dynamic JavaScript code, and rendering a Smarty template for the user interface.

classes.name: ViewSearchProperties
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the display of search property settings in the SuiteCRM Connectors interface. It extends 'ViewList' and overrides the process and display methods to prepare data and render the search properties template.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sets various display options such as showing all items, enabling JavaScript, hiding header and footer, then calls the parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads necessary connector utilities, gathers source and search definitions, constructs JavaScript configuration data for the interface, and renders the 'search_properties.tpl' Smarty template with relevant data assigned to the template engine.
